title: Simplexwise test for universal categorical equivalences
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices and degreewise pullbacks from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and categorical equivalences in the homotopy-category testing convention of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure]. Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{p}S$ be maps of small simplicial sets in a fixed universe. For a small simplicial set $T$ with a map $t:T\to S$, put $X_T=X\times_S T$, $Y_T=Y\times_S T$, and $f_T=f\times_S\operatorname{id}_T$. Then the following conditions are equivalent: (i) $f_T$ is a categorical equivalence for every such $T,t$; (ii) for every $r\geq0$ and every simplex $\sigma:\Delta^r\to S$, the map $f_{\Delta^r}:X\times_S\Delta^r\to Y\times_S\Delta^r$ is a categorical equivalence. No quasicategory, fibration, injectivity or finiteness assumption is imposed on $X,Y,S,f,p,T,t$. Empty simplicial sets are allowed.

source.place: Proposition 3.2.2.8, printed p. 181 (PDF page 199): simplexwise criterion for categorical equivalences after every base change. Read online 2026-10-17; archival HTT copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical result.
